description:
Parsed local git status: branch, ahead/behind vs upstream, and every changed file with staged/unstaged/untracked state and staged/worktree status letters.
Use when: you need the current repo state in a parseable form (before committing, stashing or opening a PR).
Avoid when: you only need the raw command (shell_run) or a remote host’s CI status (ci_status).
Output: ok, branch/detached, upstream (gone flag), ahead/behind, files[] {path, old_path?, staged, unstaged, untracked, unmerged, kind, status, index_status/worktree_status}, counts{}, clean.

paths.description: Optional workspace-relative paths to limit the status.

name: git_status
title: Git status
